headword: {損益計算書|そんえきけいさんしょ}
reading: そんえきけいさんしょ
gloss: income statement; profit and loss statement

definitions.gloss: income statement; profit and loss statement
definitions.explanation: A financial statement that summarizes a company's revenues, expenses, and profits over a specific period.

examples.japanese: {損益計算書|そんえきけいさんしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}れば→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わかる。
examples.english: You can see the profit by looking at the income statement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今期|こんき}→今期：29530_konki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{損益計算書|そんえきけいさんしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{前年比|ぜんねんひ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In this period's income statement, sales have increased compared to the previous year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{投資家|とうしか}→投資家：16242_toushika⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{貸借対照表|たいしゃくたいしょうひょう}→貸借対照表：24521_taishakutaishouhyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{損益計算書|そんえきけいさんしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{分析|ぶんせき}する→分析する：25338_bunsekisuru⟧ことで、⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{経営状態|けいえいじょうたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧より⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{把握|はあく}できる→把握する：19628_haakusuru⟧。
examples.english: By analyzing the balance sheet and income statement together, investors can grasp a company's management condition more accurately.

notes:
Literally "profit-loss calculation document." Often abbreviated as P/L (from the English "profit and loss"). Shows how much money a company earned and spent over a period such as a quarter or fiscal year.

The key line items include ⟦{売上高|うりあげだか}→売上高：12376_uriagedaka⟧ (revenue), {売上原価|うりあげげんか} (cost of sales), ⟦{営業利益|えいぎょうりえき}→営業利益：22690_eigyourieki⟧ (operating profit), and {当期純利益|とうきじゅんりえき} (net income).
